FB Auto Post

Automates posting text and media to Facebook News Feed and Groups.

How to use

  1. Navigate to facebook.com
  2. A floating panel will appear at the top-right corner
  3. Enter your post content and attach media files
  4. Select target: News Feed or Current Group
  5. Click RUN AUTO POST

Tips

  • The panel is draggable - move it anywhere on the page
  • Click — to minimize, × to hide
  • Click CANCEL to abort mid-posting
  • Supports both English and Vietnamese Facebook interfaces
